missing_prerequisite: No personal Linux arm64 host is reachable, and this runner has no cloud provisioning credential or CLI for AWS, GCP, Azure, Hetzner, Oracle, Fly, or DigitalOcean. The runner is Linux x86_64.

setup_proposal.recommended_ram: 8 GiB so kernel overhead still leaves MemTotal at or above the measured envelope
setup_proposal.recommended_disk: A dedicated durable ext4 volume of at least 64 GiB for /var/lib/phebs-typed-acceptance and /var/lib/phebs-typed-preparation. 64 GiB is operator headroom under the existing ceiling, not a new limit.
setup_proposal.docker: API v1.47 on /var/run/docker.sock, features.time-namespaces=false, dockerd --validate, restart, and zero containers before admission
setup_proposal.transport_ssh: PHEBS_TYPED_NATIVE_TRANSPORT=ssh and PHEBS_TYPED_NATIVE_SSH_TARGET=user@host, with the host key pinned in known_hosts and sudo -n python3 permitted
setup_proposal.transport_direct: On that same arm64 host, PHEBS_TYPED_NATIVE_TRANSPORT=direct
setup_proposal.retention: Keep failed stage directories and collected receipts on that volume. Do not delete failed custody to create free space.
setup_proposal.excluded_host: Do not use Ben's Mac or its Colima VM.
